pro_course_detail.title: Master your English Conversational Skills!
pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Overview

Enhance your English speaking skills through engaging and meaningful conversations! This lesson is designed to improve your fluency, expand your vocabulary, and refine your pronunciation and grammar. Whether you're looking to practice everyday conversations or discuss specific topics of interest, this lesson will provide a structured yet flexible approach to help you achieve your language goals.

What to Expect

1. Warm-Up: We’ll start with a casual chat to make you feel comfortable and ready to speak in English.
   
2. Topic Introduction: Each lesson features a relevant and interesting topic tailored to your interests and current events.

3. Vocabulary Building: Learn and practice new words related to the topic, including their meanings and usage in sentences.

4. Reading Activity: Read a short article or story aloud, improving pronunciation and comprehension.

5. Discussion Questions: Engage in a lively discussion, sharing your thoughts and opinions while receiving real-time feedback on your language use.

6. Role-Play Activity: Practice real-life scenarios to enhance your conversational skills in a fun and practical way.

7. Feedback and Corrections: Receive constructive feedback on your strengths and areas for improvement in speaking, grammar, and vocabulary.

8. Homework Assignment: Reinforce learning with a short writing task to practice new vocabulary and structures.

9. Q&A and Wrap-Up: Ask any questions you have and review key points from the lesson, setting the stage for continued improvement.

pro_course_detail.title: English Explorers - Language Adventures for Children!
pro_course_detail.description:
As a seasoned teacher with 3 years of experience working with children aged 2 to 17, I’m skilled in making English learning an exciting adventure! My lesson plans are adaptable to each child's unique learning needs, ensuring that every lesson is fun, interactive, and educational. Whether your child is just beginning or already advancing in English, I’m here to guide them through every step of the journey.

Course Overview:

1. Phonics and Pronunciation:
Sound it Out: Mastering phonics to recognize and pronounce English sounds.
Rhyming Fun: Engaging with rhymes and songs to make learning enjoyable.
Tongue Twisters: Fun exercises to improve pronunciation.

2. Vocabulary Building:
Word of the Day: Introducing new words daily with examples.
Themed Vocabulary: Topics like animals and colors to enhance memory.
Interactive Flashcards: Visual aids to reinforce vocabulary.

3. Grammar Basics:
Grammar Games: Fun activities to introduce simple grammar rules.
Sentence Building: Constructing basic sentences using new vocabulary.
Storytime: Reading stories to highlight grammar points.

4. Reading and Comprehension:
Story Adventures: Reading and discussing age-appropriate stories.
Picture Books: Enhancing comprehension with illustrated books.
Comprehension Quizzes: Simple questions to check understanding.

5. Speaking and Listening:
Role-Playing: Practicing English in everyday scenarios.
Listening Games: Improving listening skills through fun activities.
Show and Tell: Encouraging children to speak about their interests.

6. Writing Skills:
Creative Writing: Prompts to inspire short sentences and stories.
Letter Formation: Practicing correct letter and word formation.
Word Puzzles: Fun activities to reinforce spelling and vocabulary.

7. Cultural Exploration:
Around the World: Exploring English-speaking cultures through music and traditions.
Holiday Fun: Learning about holidays like Halloween and Christmas.
Songs and Games: Traditional English songs and games.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
Hi there! 🤗 I’m so glad you’ve visited my profile! It looks like I should share a bit more beyond what’s in my video, so here’s a little extra about me: I’m a huge Marvel fan, I love practicing yoga, and I’m passionate about hip-hop and zumba! 💃🏼

As a teacher, I see mistakes as a natural part of the learning process. They show you're trying and give us the chance to improve together.
teacher_info.teaching_style: My lessons are personalized to fit each student’s goals and abilities. Every student has their own Google document where we can share ideas, materials, and homework. I incorporate a mix of books and online resources in my lessons, and lately, my students have really enjoyed using TED Talks as part of our learning.

exp_info.description: I used to be a lifeguard at Camp Kennebec, Ontario. Apart from living with and taking care of my campers, I also held yoga, dance, water sport, and swimming lessons as well. I undertook lifeguard training for this position.
I taught English to teenagers and adults. In the 25-minute lessons, students had the option to decide what they wanted to practice.
I worked in a kindergarten as well as in a high school. I always tried to make my lessons special and unforgettable. I used a lot of creative techniques as well as modern types of equipment.

I teach English as a second language in a private English school called “Don’t Panic”. My students vary from A1 level to C1. The main objective of the school is to enhance the communication skills of the students as well as prepare them for different tests.

I had the opportunity to be an active member of the Foreign Affairs Committee at the University of Szeged. My task was to inform foreign students of events and translate their documents from English and Serbian to Hungarian. These documents were required to obtain various scholarships.

As survey leader, I was in charge of handing out questionnaires on the topic of youth. It summarised some of the most important questions relating to subjects, such as political view, affiliation, religion, and others. This work perfected my knowledge of the Serbian and Croatian languages.

exp_info.company: Long Lake Camp for the Arts
exp_info.description: I worked in Long Lake Camp, located in the state of New York. My duties included inventory management and serving food. Thanks to this camp, my knowledge of the English language improved significantly.
I served gourmet dishes and beverages in a five-star hotel on Mackinac Island, Michigan. During this job, I developed my English language skills and gained valuable insight into American culture.
